interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to slow traffic and repurpose space for wider sidewalks or protected bike lanes.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns at regular intervals to provide safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at intersections to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Utility Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate the utility pole to the edge of the sidewalk or underground to provide a clear, unobstructed path for all users, including those with mobility devices.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer / Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone between the curb and the sidewalk to provide physical and psychological separation from moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians and allow for two-stage crossing.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicle traffic is released.

interventions.title: Midblock Crossing with Refuge
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a raised pedestrian refuge island to reduce crossing distance and exposure.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous sidewalk on the near side of the street to provide a safe, separated path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Narrow and consolidate driveway entrances to the commercial property to reduce the speed of turning vehicles and the length of the conflict zone.

interventions.title: Street trees and enhanced buffer
interventions.description: Formalize the planting strip with street trees to provide a more substantial physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the alley entrance to the level of the sidewalk to slow turning vehicles and provide a level path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at the sidewalk terminations.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Infill
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk on the near side of the street to provide a safe walking path.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Add a landscaped buffer or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the roadway to increase physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Curb extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at potential crossing points to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Speed humps or cushions
interventions.description: Implement vertical speed control measures to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential context.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add a planting strip with street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical buffer and improve the walking environment.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential setting.

interventions.title: Midblock Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk and Signage
interventions.description: Mark a high-visibility continental crosswalk and install pedestrian crossing warning signs.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lights to improve visibility of pedestrians at night, as none are currently visible.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to maintain low vehicle speeds appropriate for a residential row-house environment.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated space for pedestrians to cross.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant street trees in the grass buffer to provide vertical enclosure, which naturally encourages slower driving speeds and improves the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to ensure the sidewalk and roadway are well-illuminated for nighttime safety.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Narrow the travel lanes through striping or physical barriers to naturally slow vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing and Curb Radii Reduction
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the commercial driveway and tighten the curb radii to slow turning vehicles and shorten the pedestrian crossing distance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk, potentially with a pedestrian refuge island and RRFB (Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon) to facilitate safe crossing.

interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation from high-speed traffic.
